par.run: IOI PAN-CENTURY EDIBLE OILS SDN BHD
The objective of this appraisal is to review staff performance and achievements for the review period so as to provide
a basis for compensation and benefits and to provide feedback for staff training needs and career development purposes
The “Supplementary Worksheet” is provided separately in Excel sheet to help you to calculate for the total score
Exceptional performance that exceeds expectations and is consistently outstanding.
Consistently exceeds job requirements and expectations.
Consistently meets job requirements with minimum supervision and direction.
Satisfactory performance that meets job requirements and expectations
Satisfactory performance that meets job requirements with some supervision
Performance below expectations. Requires close supervision
Appraisal would cover various area of performance and contribution with respective weightage accorded as
Employee’s scope of job compared to previous year.
(If the Job Description fully defines the job scope, it may be attached)
If the scope of job has increased or decreased, please explain below or on separate sheet:

Sub Onchange(Source As Field) Dim ws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim uidoc As NotesUIDocument Set uidoc = ws.CurrentDocument Dim x As Double Dim q As Double Dim y As Double Dim p As Double Dim c As Double Dim e As Double Dim d As Double Dim m As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R1" ) <> "") Then x = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R1" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R2" ) <> "") Then q = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R2" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R3" ) <> "") Then y = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R3" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R4" ) <> "") Then p = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R4" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R5" ) <> "") Then c = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R5" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R6" ) <> "") Then e = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R6" ) Else Print 0 d =( x + q + y + p + c + e ) d= Round(d,1) m = (d*10)/60 m= Round(m,2) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("TR", Cstr(d)) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("MS1", Cstr(m))
Dim gd2 As Double Dim gd3 As Double Dim gTotal As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS2" ) <> "") Then gd2 = uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS2" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS3" ) <> "") Then gd3 = uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS3" ) Else Print 0 gTotal = (m + gd2 + gd3) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("GTotalE", Cstr(gTotal))
Dim b As Double Dim n As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "CONE" ) <> "") Then b = uidoc.FieldGetText( "CONE" ) Else Print 0 n =( gTotal + b ) n= Round(n,2) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("CTotalE", Cstr(n)) End Sub

Sub Onchange(Source As Field) Dim ws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim uidoc As NotesUIDocument Set uidoc = ws.CurrentDocument Dim x As Double Dim q As Double Dim y As Double Dim p As Double Dim c As Double Dim e As Double Dim f As Double Dim d As Double Dim m As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "G1" ) <> "") Then x = uidoc.FieldGetText( "G1" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "G2" ) <> "") Then q = uidoc.FieldGetText( "G2" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "G3" ) <> "") Then y = uidoc.FieldGetText( "G3" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "G4" ) <> "") Then p = uidoc.FieldGetText( "G4" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "G5" ) <> "") Then c = uidoc.FieldGetText( "G5" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "G6" ) <> "") Then e = uidoc.FieldGetText( "G6" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "G7" ) <> "") Then f = uidoc.FieldGetText( "G7" ) Else Print 0 d =( x + q + y + p + c + e + f ) d= Round(d,1) m = (d*50)/70 m= Round(m,2) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("GT", Cstr(d)) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("MS2", Cstr(m))
Dim gd1 As Double Dim gd3 As Double Dim gTotal As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS1" ) <> "") Then gd1 = uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS1" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS3" ) <> "") Then gd3 = uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS3" ) Else Print 0 gTotal = (gd1 + m + gd3) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("GTotalE", Cstr(gTotal))
Dim b As Double Dim n As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "CONE" ) <> "") Then b = uidoc.FieldGetText( "CONE" ) Else Print 0 n =( gTotal + b ) n= Round(n,2) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("CTotalE", Cstr(n))
End Sub

Sub Onchange(Source As Field) Dim ws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim uidoc As NotesUIDocument Set uidoc = ws.CurrentDocument

item.name: $$GR_1_1
item.text:
'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:5:(Options):0:66
'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:5:(Forward):0:1 Declare Sub Onchange(Source As Field)
'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:5:(Declarations):0:2
'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:2:BindEvents:1:129 Private Sub BindEvents(Byval Objectname_ As String) Static Source As FIELD Set Source = Bind(Objectname_) On Event Onchange From Source Call Onchange End Sub
'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:2:Onchange:1:12 Sub Onchange(Source As Field) Dim ws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim uidoc As NotesUIDocument Set uidoc = ws.CurrentDocument Dim x As Double Dim q As Double Dim y As Double Dim p As Double Dim c As Double Dim e As Double Dim f As Double Dim d As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_1" ) <> "") Then x = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_1" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_2" ) <> "") Then q = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_2" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_3" ) <> "") Then y = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_3" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_4" ) <> "") Then p = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_4" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_5" ) <> "") Then c = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_5" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_6" ) <> "") Then e = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_6" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_7" ) <> "") Then f = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_7" ) Else Print 0 d =( x + q + y + p + c + e + f) d= Round(d,1) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("GRT", Cstr(d)) End Sub

item.text: EmpForm

code.lotusscript:
Sub Click(Source As Button) Dim session As New NotesSession Dim uiws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim form As NotesForm Dim db As NotesDatabase Dim doc As NotesDocument Dim item As NotesItem Dim row As Integer
Dim xlFilename As String Dim xlsApp As Variant Dim xlsWorkBook As Variant Dim xlsSheet As Variant Dim rows As Long Dim cols As Integer Dim x As Integer Dim itemName As String Dim flag As Integer Dim formAlias As String Dim sortEval As String Dim sortedList As Variant Dim indexLo As Long Dim indexHi As Long
On Error Goto ErrorHandler
Set db = session.CurrentDatabase
fn= uiws.Prompt(1, "Alert", "Make sure that the first row of your worksheet contains the EXACT Notes document field names from your form.")
'Get Excel file name fn =uiws.OpenFileDialog(False, "Select the Excel File to Import", "Excel files | *.xls", "c:My Documents") xlFilename = Cstr(fn(0)) ' This is the name of the Excel file that will be imported
'Get list of form names x=0
Print "Preparing List of Database Forms ..."
Forall f In db.Forms Redim Preserve formlist(x) formlist(x)=f.name x=x+1 Print "Preparing List of Database Forms ..."& Cstr(x) End Forall
'Choose the form to use for import formname = uiws.Prompt(4, "Choose Import Form", "Please select which form is to be used for this input.", formlist(0), formlist) If formname= "" Then End
'Get the form object so that we can check field names Set form= db.GetForm(formname)
'If the form has an alias, use it to select the form If Not Isempty(form.Aliases) Then Forall a In form.Aliases formname=a End Forall 'a In form.Aliases End If 'Not Isempty(form.Aliases)
'Next we connect to Excel and open the file. Then start pulling over the records. Print "Connecting to Excel..."
' Create the excel object Set xlsApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
'Open the file Print "Opening the file : " & xlfilename xlsApp.Workbooks.Open xlfilename Set xlsWorkBook = xlsApp.ActiveWorkbook Set xlsSheet = xlsWorkBook.ActiveSheet xlsApp.Visible = False ' Do not show Excel To user xlsSheet.Cells.SpecialCells(11).Activate rows = xlsApp.ActiveWindow.ActiveCell.Row ' Number of rows to process cols = xlsApp.ActiveWindow.ActiveCell.Column ' Number of columns to process
'Make sure we start at row 0 row = 0 Print "Starting import from Excel file..."
Do While True row = row + 1
'Check to make sure we did not run out of rows If row= rows+1 Then Goto Done
'field definitions for notes come from first row (row, column) If row=1 Then For i=1 To cols Redim Preserve fd(i) fd(i)=xlsSheet.Cells( row, i ).Value flag=0
Forall f In form.Fields If Lcase(fd(i)) = Lcase(f) Then flag=1 End Forall 'f In form.Fields
If flag=1 Then Goto Skip End If ' flag=1
If Not flag=1 Then msg="The field name "& fd(i) &" does not appear in the form you have chosen. Exiting import." Msgbox msg Goto ErrorHandler End If 'flag=1
Skip: Next 'For i=1 To cols End If 'row=1
'Import each row into a new document If Not row = 1 Then
'Create a new doc Set doc = db.CreateDocument doc.Form = FormName
For i= 1 To cols Set item = doc.ReplaceItemValue( fd(i), xlsSheet.Cells( row, i ).Value ) Next ' i= 1 To cols
'Save the new doc Call doc.Save( True, True )
End If 'Not row = 1 Then
Print "Processing document number "& Cstr(row) & " of " & Cstr(rows)
Loop 'Do while true
Done:
Print "Disconnecting from Excel..." 'Close the Excel file without saving (we made no changes) xlsWorkbook.Close False 'Close Excel xlsApp.Quit 'Free the memory that we'd used Set xlsApp = Nothing
'Clear the status line Print " "
ErrorHandler: If Err = 184 Then Msgbox "No file chosen. Exiting Import." Print "No file chosen. Exiting Import." Resume ErrorOut End If ' err=184
If Err = 6 Then Messagebox "Make sure that you do not have more than 65,536 rows of data to import." ,MB_OK+MB_ICONINFORMATION,"Error! " Print "Too many rows in Excel document. Exiting Import. Disconnecting from Excel..." 'Close the Excel file without saving (we made no changes) xlsWorkbook.Close False 'Close Excel xlsApp.Quit 'Free the memory that we'd used Set xlsApp = Nothing Resume ErrorOut End If ' err=184
If (Err) And (Not Err = 184) And (Not Err = 6) Then
Msgbox "Lotus Notes Error # " & Err &". Please contact your Notes administrator for help. Exiting Import." Print "Error # "& Err
If Not xlsWorkbook Is Nothing Then xlsWorkbook.Close False End If ' Not xlsWorkbook Is Nothing
If Not xlsApp Is Nothing Then xlsApp.Quit False End If 'Not xlsApp Is Nothing
Resume ErrorOut
End If '(Err) And (Not Err = 184) And (Not Err = 6)
ErrorOut: End Sub

(ii) KPIs set must be SMART: Specific, Measurable, Attainable, Relevant and Time Bound. Some KPIs may be more significant than the others.
Assign higher weightage for KPI that require higher degree of concentration of effort or KPI that carry higher impact to the job, using
(minimum 10% and maximum 30%). The grand total must equal to 100%.
(iii) Please ensure that you make copies of this KRA/KPI planning (one for the Appraisee and one for the Appraiser) for follow-up and review during the
review period. Submit the original form to Human Resource Department.
Note: Their culture applicable only during the reies for annual appraisal
Column (b) Use Rating Scales 1-100 below when filling this column
Column (C) Multiply each KPI rating score (b) with the corresponding weightage(a)
Note : This KRA Score (Summation) is required to input into Section D of the appraisal at the end of the financial year.

Sub Click(Source As Button)
Dim session As New NotesSession Dim db As NotesDatabase Dim WS As New Notesuiworkspace Dim v As NotesView Dim UiView As notesuiview Dim ViewString As String Dim xl As Variant Dim xlSheet As Variant
Const View$="SummaryHR" Const ExportItem$="Export" Const xlsSave$="False" Const xlsFileName$="c:\temp\temp Export.xls"
Set db=session.CurrentDatabase Set v=db.GetView(View$) Set xl=CreateObject("Excel.Application") xl.Workbooks.Add Set xlSheet = xl.Workbooks(1).Worksheets(1)
col!=1 Forall vColumn In v.Columns xlSheet.Cells(1, col!)=vColumn.Title col!=col!+1 End Forall
Dim docX As NotesDocument Set docX=v.GetFirstDocument row!=2 While Not docX Is Nothing col!=1 Set item=docX.GetFirstItem(ExportItem$) Process=True 'If item Is Nothing Then ' Process=True 'Elseif item.Text="" Then ' Process=True 'End If If Process=True Then Forall cValue In docX.ColumnValues xlSheet.Cells(row!, col!)=cValue col!=col!+1 End Forall row!=row!+1 End If Call docX.ReplaceItemValue(ExportItem$, Now) Call docX.Save (True, True) Set docX=v.GetNextDocument(docX) Wend
If xlsSave$="True" Then Call xl.SaveAs(xlsFileName$) Call xl.Close Else xl.Visible=True End If ErrorOut: End Sub

Sub Onchange(Source As Field) Dim ws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim uidoc As NotesUIDocument Set uidoc = ws.CurrentDocument Dim x As Double Dim q As Double Dim y As Double Dim p As Double Dim c As Double Dim e As Double Dim d As Double Dim m As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R1" ) <> "") Then x = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R1" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R2" ) <> "") Then q = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R2" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R3" ) <> "") Then y = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R3" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R4" ) <> "") Then p = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R4" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R5" ) <> "") Then c = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R5" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R6" ) <> "") Then e = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R6" ) Else Print 0 d =( x + q + y + p + c + e ) d= Round(d,1) m = (d*10)/60 m= Round(m,2) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("TR", Cstr(d)) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("PCR", Cstr(m)) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("MS1", Cstr(m))
Dim gd1 As Double Dim gd2 As Double Dim gd3 As Double Dim gTotal As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS1" ) <> "") Then gd1 = uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS1" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS2" ) <> "") Then gd2 = uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS2" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS3" ) <> "") Then gd3 = uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS3" ) Else Print 0 gTotal = (gd1 + gd2 + gd3) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("GTotal", Cstr(gTotal)) End Sub

Sub Onchange(Source As Field) Dim ws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim uidoc As NotesUIDocument Set uidoc = ws.CurrentDocument Dim a As Double Dim b As Double Dim d As Double Dim m As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "W1" ) <> "") Then a = uidoc.FieldGetText( "W1" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "RT1" ) <> "") Then b = uidoc.FieldGetText( "RT1" ) Else Print 0 d =( a * b )/100 d= Round(d,2) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("SC1", Cstr(d))
Dim x As Double Dim q As Double Dim y As Double Dim p As Double Dim c As Double Dim e As Double Dim f As Double Dim n As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "SC1" ) <> "") Then x = uidoc.FieldGetText( "SC1" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "SC2" ) <> "") Then q = uidoc.FieldGetText( "SC2" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "SC3" ) <> "") Then y = uidoc.FieldGetText( "SC3" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "SC4" ) <> "") Then p = uidoc.FieldGetText( "SC4" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "SC5" ) <> "") Then c = uidoc.FieldGetText( "SC5" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "SC6" ) <> "") Then e = uidoc.FieldGetText( "SC6" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "SC7" ) <> "") Then f = uidoc.FieldGetText( "SC7" ) Else Print 0 n = ( x + q + y + p + c + e + f) n = Round(n,2) m = (n/10)*40 m= Round(m,2) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("SCR", Cstr(n)) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("SCRP", Cstr(m)) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("MS3", Cstr(m))
Dim gd1 As Double Dim gd2 As Double Dim gd3 As Double Dim gTotal As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS1" ) <> "") Then gd1 = uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS1" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS2" ) <> "") Then gd2 = uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS2" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS3" ) <> "") Then gd3 = uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS3" ) Else Print 0 gTotal = (gd1 + gd2 + gd3) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("GTotal", Cstr(gTotal))
End Sub

par.run: Level 1 - Lacks both theoretical knowledge and practical ability (needs to be taught)
Level 2 - Knows in theory but not in practice (needs practical training)
Level 3 - Has mastered practice but not theory (cannot teach others)
Level 4 - Has mastered both theory and practice (can teach others)

item.name: $$GR_1_1
item.text:
'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:5:(Options):0:66
'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:5:(Forward):0:1 Declare Sub Onchange(Source As Field)
'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:5:(Declarations):0:2
'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:2:BindEvents:1:129 Private Sub BindEvents(Byval Objectname_ As String) Static Source As FIELD Set Source = Bind(Objectname_) On Event Onchange From Source Call Onchange End Sub
'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:2:Onchange:1:12 Sub Onchange(Source As Field) Dim ws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim uidoc As NotesUIDocument Set uidoc = ws.CurrentDocument Dim x As Double Dim q As Double Dim y As Double Dim p As Double Dim c As Double Dim e As Double Dim f As Double Dim d As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_1" ) <> "") Then x = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_1" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_2" ) <> "") Then q = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_2" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_3" ) <> "") Then y = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_3" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_4" ) <> "") Then p = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_4" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_5" ) <> "") Then c = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_5" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_6" ) <> "") Then e = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_6" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_7" ) <> "") Then f = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_7" ) Else Print 0 d =( x + q + y + p + c + e + f) d= Round(d,1) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("GRT", Cstr(d)) End Sub

Level 4 - Has mastered both theory and practice (can teach others)

item.name: $$GR_1_1
item.text:
'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:5:(Options):0:66
'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:5:(Forward):0:1 Declare Sub Onchange(Source As Field)
'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:5:(Declarations):0:2
'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:2:BindEvents:1:129 Private Sub BindEvents(Byval Objectname_ As String) Static Source As FIELD Set Source = Bind(Objectname_) On Event Onchange From Source Call Onchange End Sub
'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:2:Onchange:1:12 Sub Onchange(Source As Field) Dim ws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim uidoc As NotesUIDocument Set uidoc = ws.CurrentDocument Dim x As Double Dim q As Double Dim y As Double Dim p As Double Dim c As Double Dim e As Double Dim f As Double Dim d As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_1" ) <> "") Then x = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_1" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_2" ) <> "") Then q = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_2" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_3" ) <> "") Then y = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_3" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_4" ) <> "") Then p = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_4" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_5" ) <> "") Then c = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_5" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_6" ) <> "") Then e = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_6" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_7" ) <> "") Then f = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_7" ) Else Print 0 d =( x + q + y + p + c + e + f) d= Round(d,1) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("GRT", Cstr(d)) End Sub

Sub Click(Source As Button)
Dim session As New NotesSession Dim db As NotesDatabase Dim WS As New Notesuiworkspace Dim v As NotesView Dim UiView As notesuiview Dim ViewString As String Dim xl As Variant Dim xlSheet As Variant
Const View$="Training" Const ExportItem$="Export" Const xlsSave$="False" Const xlsFileName$="c:\temp\temp Export.xls"
Set db=session.CurrentDatabase Set v=db.GetView(View$) Set xl=CreateObject("Excel.Application") xl.Workbooks.Add Set xlSheet = xl.Workbooks(1).Worksheets(1)
col!=1 Forall vColumn In v.Columns xlSheet.Cells(1, col!)=vColumn.Title col!=col!+1 End Forall
Dim docX As NotesDocument Set docX=v.GetFirstDocument row!=2 While Not docX Is Nothing col!=1 Set item=docX.GetFirstItem(ExportItem$) Process=True 'If item Is Nothing Then ' Process=True 'Elseif item.Text="" Then ' Process=True 'End If If Process=True Then Forall cValue In docX.ColumnValues xlSheet.Cells(row!, col!)=cValue col!=col!+1 End Forall row!=row!+1 End If Call docX.ReplaceItemValue(ExportItem$, Now) Call docX.Save (True, True) Set docX=v.GetNextDocument(docX) Wend
If xlsSave$="True" Then Call xl.SaveAs(xlsFileName$) Call xl.Close Else xl.Visible=True End If ErrorOut: End Sub

Sub Click(Source As Button) Dim session As New NotesSession Dim uiws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim form As NotesForm Dim db As NotesDatabase Dim doc As NotesDocument Dim item As NotesItem Dim row As Integer
Dim xlFilename As String Dim xlsApp As Variant Dim xlsWorkBook As Variant Dim xlsSheet As Variant Dim rows As Long Dim cols As Integer Dim x As Integer Dim itemName As String Dim flag As Integer Dim formAlias As String Dim sortEval As String Dim sortedList As Variant Dim indexLo As Long Dim indexHi As Long
On Error Goto ErrorHandler
Set db = session.CurrentDatabase
fn= uiws.Prompt(1, "Alert", "Make sure that the first row of your worksheet contains the EXACT Notes document field names from your form.")
'Get Excel file name fn =uiws.OpenFileDialog(False, "Select the Excel File to Import", "Excel files | *.xls", "c:My Documents") xlFilename = Cstr(fn(0)) ' This is the name of the Excel file that will be imported
'Get list of form names x=0
Print "Preparing List of Database Forms ..."
Forall f In db.Forms Redim Preserve formlist(x) formlist(x)=f.name x=x+1 Print "Preparing List of Database Forms ..."& Cstr(x) End Forall
'Choose the form to use for import formname = uiws.Prompt(4, "Choose Import Form", "Please select which form is to be used for this input.", formlist(0), formlist) If formname= "" Then End
'Get the form object so that we can check field names Set form= db.GetForm(formname)
'If the form has an alias, use it to select the form If Not Isempty(form.Aliases) Then Forall a In form.Aliases formname=a End Forall 'a In form.Aliases End If 'Not Isempty(form.Aliases)
'Next we connect to Excel and open the file. Then start pulling over the records. Print "Connecting to Excel..."
' Create the excel object Set xlsApp = CreateObject("Excel.Application")
'Open the file Print "Opening the file : " & xlfilename xlsApp.Workbooks.Open xlfilename Set xlsWorkBook = xlsApp.ActiveWorkbook Set xlsSheet = xlsWorkBook.ActiveSheet xlsApp.Visible = False ' Do not show Excel To user xlsSheet.Cells.SpecialCells(11).Activate rows = xlsApp.ActiveWindow.ActiveCell.Row ' Number of rows to process cols = xlsApp.ActiveWindow.ActiveCell.Column ' Number of columns to process
'Make sure we start at row 0 row = 0 Print "Starting import from Excel file..."
Do While True row = row + 1
'Check to make sure we did not run out of rows If row= rows+1 Then Goto Done
'field definitions for notes come from first row (row, column) If row=1 Then For i=1 To cols Redim Preserve fd(i) fd(i)=xlsSheet.Cells( row, i ).Value flag=0
Forall f In form.Fields If Lcase(fd(i)) = Lcase(f) Then flag=1 End Forall 'f In form.Fields
If flag=1 Then Goto Skip End If ' flag=1
If Not flag=1 Then msg="The field name "& fd(i) &" does not appear in the form you have chosen. Exiting import." Msgbox msg Goto ErrorHandler End If 'flag=1
Skip: Next 'For i=1 To cols End If 'row=1
'Import each row into a new document If Not row = 1 Then
'Create a new doc Set doc = db.CreateDocument doc.Form = FormName
For i= 1 To cols Set item = doc.ReplaceItemValue( fd(i), xlsSheet.Cells( row, i ).Value ) Next ' i= 1 To cols
'Save the new doc Call doc.Save( True, True )
End If 'Not row = 1 Then
Print "Processing document number "& Cstr(row) & " of " & Cstr(rows)
Loop 'Do while true
Done:
Print "Disconnecting from Excel..." 'Close the Excel file without saving (we made no changes) xlsWorkbook.Close False 'Close Excel xlsApp.Quit 'Free the memory that we'd used Set xlsApp = Nothing
'Clear the status line Print " "
ErrorHandler: If Err = 184 Then Msgbox "No file chosen. Exiting Import." Print "No file chosen. Exiting Import." Resume ErrorOut End If ' err=184
If Err = 6 Then Messagebox "Make sure that you do not have more than 65,536 rows of data to import." ,MB_OK+MB_ICONINFORMATION,"Error! " Print "Too many rows in Excel document. Exiting Import. Disconnecting from Excel..." 'Close the Excel file without saving (we made no changes) xlsWorkbook.Close False 'Close Excel xlsApp.Quit 'Free the memory that we'd used Set xlsApp = Nothing Resume ErrorOut End If ' err=184
If (Err) And (Not Err = 184) And (Not Err = 6) Then
Msgbox "Lotus Notes Error # " & Err &". Please contact your Notes administrator for help. Exiting Import." Print "Error # "& Err
If Not xlsWorkbook Is Nothing Then xlsWorkbook.Close False End If ' Not xlsWorkbook Is Nothing
If Not xlsApp Is Nothing Then xlsApp.Quit False End If 'Not xlsApp Is Nothing
Resume ErrorOut
End If '(Err) And (Not Err = 184) And (Not Err = 6)
ErrorOut: End Sub

'Open the file Print "Opening the file : " & xlfilename xlsApp.Workbooks.Open xlfilename Set xlsWorkBook = xlsApp.ActiveWorkbook Set xlsSheet = xlsWorkBook.ActiveSheet xlsApp.Visible = False ' Do not show Excel To user xlsSheet.Cells.SpecialCells(11).Activate rows = xlsApp.ActiveWindow.ActiveCell.Row ' Number of rows to process cols = xlsApp.ActiveWindow.ActiveCell.Column ' Number of columns to process
'Make sure we start at row 0 row = 0 Print "Starting import from Excel file..."
Do While True row = row + 1
'Check to make sure we did not run out of rows If row= rows+1 Then Goto Done
'field definitions for notes come from first row (row, column) If row=1 Then For i=1 To cols Redim Preserve fd(i) fd(i)=xlsSheet.Cells( row, i ).Value flag=0
Forall f In form.Fields If Lcase(fd(i)) = Lcase(f) Then flag=1 End Forall 'f In form.Fields
If flag=1 Then Goto Skip End If ' flag=1
If Not flag=1 Then msg="The field name "& fd(i) &" does not appear in the form you have chosen. Exiting import." Msgbox msg Goto ErrorHandler End If 'flag=1
Skip: Next 'For i=1 To cols End If 'row=1
'Import each row into a new document If Not row = 1 Then
'Create a new doc Set doc = db.CreateDocument doc.Form = FormName
For i= 1 To cols Set item = doc.ReplaceItemValue( fd(i), xlsSheet.Cells( row, i ).Value ) Next ' i= 1 To cols
'Save the new doc Call doc.Save( True, True )
End If 'Not row = 1 Then
Print "Processing document number "& Cstr(row) & " of " & Cstr(rows)
Loop 'Do while true
Done:
Print "Disconnecting from Excel..." 'Close the Excel file without saving (we made no changes) xlsWorkbook.Close False 'Close Excel xlsApp.Quit 'Free the memory that we'd used Set xlsApp = Nothing
'Clear the status line Print " "
ErrorHandler: If Err = 184 Then Msgbox "No file chosen. Exiting Import." Print "No file chosen. Exiting Import." Resume ErrorOut End If ' err=184
If Err = 6 Then Messagebox "Make sure that you do not have more than 65,536 rows of data to import." ,MB_OK+MB_ICONINFORMATION,"Error! " Print "Too many rows in Excel document. Exiting Import. Disconnecting from Excel..." 'Close the Excel file without saving (we made no changes) xlsWorkbook.Close False 'Close Excel xlsApp.Quit 'Free the memory that we'd used Set xlsApp = Nothing Resume ErrorOut End If ' err=184
If (Err) And (Not Err = 184) And (Not Err = 6) Then
Msgbox "Lotus Notes Error # " & Err &". Please contact your Notes administrator for help. Exiting Import." Print "Error # "& Err
If Not xlsWorkbook Is Nothing Then xlsWorkbook.Close False End If ' Not xlsWorkbook Is Nothing
If Not xlsApp Is Nothing Then xlsApp.Quit False End If 'Not xlsApp Is Nothing
Resume ErrorOut
End If '(Err) And (Not Err = 184) And (Not Err = 6)
ErrorOut: End Sub

'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:2:Onchange:1:12 Sub Onchange(Source As Field) Dim ws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim uidoc As NotesUIDocument Set uidoc = ws.CurrentDocument Dim x As Double Dim q As Double Dim y As Double Dim p As Double Dim c As Double Dim e As Double Dim f As Double Dim d As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_1" ) <> "") Then x = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_1" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_2" ) <> "") Then q = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_2" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_3" ) <> "") Then y = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_3" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_4" ) <> "") Then p = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_4" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_5" ) <> "") Then c = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_5" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_6" ) <> "") Then e = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_6" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_7" ) <> "") Then f = uidoc.FieldGetText( "GR_7" ) Else Print 0 d =( x + q + y + p + c + e + f) d= Round(d,1) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("GRT", Cstr(d)) End Sub

'++LotusScript Development Environment:2:2:Onchange:1:12 Sub Onchange(Source As Field) Dim ws As New NotesUIWorkspace Dim uidoc As NotesUIDocument Set uidoc = ws.CurrentDocument Dim x As Double Dim q As Double Dim y As Double Dim p As Double Dim c As Double Dim e As Double Dim d As Double Dim m As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R1" ) <> "") Then x = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R1" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R2" ) <> "") Then q = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R2" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R3" ) <> "") Then y = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R3" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R4" ) <> "") Then p = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R4" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R5" ) <> "") Then c = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R5" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "R6" ) <> "") Then e = uidoc.FieldGetText( "R6" ) Else Print 0 d =( x + q + y + p + c + e ) d= Round(d,1) m = (d*10)/60 m= Round(m,2) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("TR", Cstr(d)) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("PCR", Cstr(m)) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("MS1", Cstr(m))
Dim gd1 As Double Dim gd2 As Double Dim gd3 As Double Dim gTotal As Double If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS1" ) <> "") Then gd1 = uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS1" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS2" ) <> "") Then gd2 = uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS2" ) Else Print 0 If (uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS3" ) <> "") Then gd3 = uidoc.FieldGetText( "MS3" ) Else Print 0 gTotal = (gd1 + gd2 + gd3) Call uidoc.FieldSetText("GTotal", Cstr(gTotal)) End Sub

item.text: EmpForm

code.lotusscript:
Sub Initialize Dim sess As New NotesSession Dim db As NotesDatabase Dim out As String Dim noteID As String Dim note As NotesDocument Dim title As String Dim flags As String Dim i As Integer Dim j As Integer Dim k As Integer Dim vType As String Dim status As String Dim lvl As String Dim entryType As String Dim colInfo As String Dim selFormula As String Dim aFlags As String Dim forms As String Dim subforms As String Dim pages As String Dim framesets As String Dim outlines As String Dim views As String Dim folders As String Dim agents As String Dim vc As NotesViewColumn Dim v As NotesView Dim vcols As Variant Dim sf As NotesForm Dim sfFields As Variant Dim remForm As NotesForm Dim remFields As Variant Dim acl As NotesACL Dim aclEntry As NotesACLEntry Dim ncForms As NotesNoteCollection Dim ncViews As NotesNoteCollection Dim ncAgents As NotesNoteCollection Dim ncAll As NotesNoteCollection Dim stream As NotesStream Dim exporter As NotesDXLExporter Dim dxl As String Dim chunkSize As Long Dim pos As Long Dim fileNum As Integer Dim fileNum2 As Integer Dim fullDxl As String Dim errLog As String Dim exportCount As Long Dim chunk As String Dim xmlDeclEnd As Long Dim dbTagStart As Long Dim dbTagEnd As Long Dim closeDbPos As Long Dim tmpPos As Long Dim msgText As String
Set db = sess.CurrentDatabase out = "DATABASE : " & db.Title & Chr(10) out = out & "PATH : " & db.FilePath & Chr(10) out = out & "DATE : " & CStr(Now()) & Chr(10) out = out & String(60, "=") & Chr(10)
' ============================================================== ' 1. FORM-CLASS NOTES ' ============================================================== Set ncForms = db.CreateNoteCollection(False) ncForms.SelectForms = True Call ncForms.BuildCollection
forms = "" : subforms = "" : pages = "" : framesets = "" : outlines = ""
noteID = ncForms.GetFirstNoteID() Do While noteID <> "" Set note = db.GetDocumentByID(noteID) title = note.GetItemValue("$TITLE")(0) flags = note.GetItemValue("$Flags")(0) If InStr(flags, "r") > 0 Then framesets = framesets & " " & title & Chr(10) ElseIf InStr(flags, "W") > 0 Then pages = pages & " " & title & Chr(10) ElseIf InStr(flags, "U") > 0 Then subforms = subforms & " " & title & Chr(10) ElseIf InStr(flags, "O") > 0 Then outlines = outlines & " " & title & Chr(10) Else forms = forms & " " & title & Chr(10) End If noteID = ncForms.GetNextNoteID(noteID) Loop
out = out & Chr(10) & "=== FRAMESETS ===" & Chr(10) If framesets = "" Then out = out & " (not accessible via SelectForms - FS exists via launch settings)" & Chr(10) Else out = out & framesets out = out & Chr(10) & "=== PAGES ===" & Chr(10) If pages = "" Then out = out & " (none)" & Chr(10) Else out = out & pages out = out & Chr(10) & "=== OUTLINES ===" & Chr(10) If outlines = "" Then out = out & " (none)" & Chr(10) Else out = out & outlines out = out & Chr(10) & "=== SUBFORMS (via $Flags) ===" & Chr(10) If subforms = "" Then out = out & " (none via $Flags)" & Chr(10) Else out = out & subforms out = out & Chr(10) & "=== FORMS ===" & Chr(10) If forms = "" Then out = out & " (none)" & Chr(10) Else out = out & forms
' ============================================================== ' 2. SUBFORMS via NotesForm API ' ============================================================== out = out & Chr(10) & "=== SUBFORMS (via NotesForm API) ===" & Chr(10) Dim sfNames(11) As String sfNames(0) = "AppAttachmentsExistingDoc" sfNames(1) = "AppAttachmentsNewDoc" sfNames(2) = "AttachmentsExistingDoc" sfNames(3) = "AttachmentsNewDoc" sfNames(4) = "ProExisting" sfNames(5) = "ProExisting2" sfNames(6) = "ProNew" sfNames(7) = "ProNew2" sfNames(8) = "RevExisting" sfNames(9) = "RevExisting2" sfNames(10) = "RevNew" sfNames(11) = "RevNew2"
For i = 0 To 11 Set sf = Nothing On Error Resume Next Set sf = db.GetForm(sfNames(i)) On Error GoTo 0 If Not sf Is Nothing Then out = out & " SUBFORM: " & sfNames(i) & Chr(10) sfFields = sf.Fields For j = 0 To UBound(sfFields) out = out & " - " & sfFields(j) & Chr(10) Next j Else out = out & " SUBFORM: " & sfNames(i) & " (not found - may be in template)" & Chr(10) End If Next i
' ============================================================== ' 3. VIEWS + COLUMN DEFINITIONS (commented out) ' ============================================================== ' Set ncViews = db.CreateNoteCollection(False) ' ncViews.SelectViews = True ' Call ncViews.BuildCollection ' ' out = out & Chr(10) & "=== VIEWS WITH COLUMNS ===" & Chr(10) ' ' noteID = ncViews.GetFirstNoteID() ' Do While noteID <> "" ' Set note = db.GetDocumentByID(noteID) ' title = note.GetItemValue("$TITLE")(0) ' flags = note.GetItemValue("$Flags")(0) ' If InStr(flags, "F") > 0 Then vType = "FOLDER" Else vType = "VIEW" ' out = out & Chr(10) & " [" & vType & "] " & title & Chr(10) ' ' On Error Resume Next ' Set v = db.GetView(title) ' If Not v Is Nothing Then ' selFormula = v.SelectionFormula ' If selFormula <> "" And UCase(selFormula) <> "SELECT @ALL" Then ' out = out & " Selection : " & selFormula & Chr(10) ' End If ' vcols = v.Columns ' If Not IsNull(vcols) Then ' For k = 0 To UBound(vcols) ' Set vc = vcols(k) ' colInfo = " Col: " & vc.Title ' If vc.IsField Then ' colInfo = colInfo & " [field=" & vc.ItemName & "]" ' ElseIf vc.IsFormula Then ' colInfo = colInfo & " [formula=" & Left(vc.Formula, 80) & "]" ' End If ' If vc.IsSorted Then colInfo = colInfo & " SORTED" ' If vc.IsCategory Then colInfo = colInfo & " CATEGORY" ' out = out & colInfo & Chr(10) ' Next k ' End If ' End If ' On Error GoTo 0 ' ' noteID = ncViews.GetNextNoteID(noteID) ' Loop
' ============================================================== ' 4. AGENTS ' ============================================================== Set ncAgents = db.CreateNoteCollection(False) ncAgents.SelectAgents = True Call ncAgents.BuildCollection
out = out & Chr(10) & "=== AGENTS ===" & Chr(10) noteID = ncAgents.GetFirstNoteID() Do While noteID <> "" Set note = db.GetDocumentByID(noteID) title = note.GetItemValue("$TITLE")(0) aFlags = "" On Error Resume Next aFlags = note.GetItemValue("$AssistFlags")(0) On Error GoTo 0 If InStr(aFlags, "E") > 0 Then status = "[ENABLED]" Else status = "[DISABLED]" out = out & " " & title & " " & status & Chr(10) noteID = ncAgents.GetNextNoteID(noteID) Loop
' ============================================================== ' 5. ACL ' ============================================================== out = out & Chr(10) & "=== ACCESS CONTROL LIST ===" & Chr(10) On Error Resume Next Set acl = db.ACL Set aclEntry = acl.GetFirstEntry() Do While Not aclEntry Is Nothing Select Case aclEntry.Level Case 0 : lvl = "No Access" Case 1 : lvl = "Depositor" Case 2 : lvl = "Reader" Case 3 : lvl = "Author" Case 4 : lvl = "Editor" Case 5 : lvl = "Designer" Case 6 : lvl = "Manager" End Select Select Case aclEntry.UserType Case 0 : entryType = "Unspecified" Case 1 : entryType = "Person" Case 2 : entryType = "Server" Case 3 : entryType = "Mixed Group" Case 4 : entryType = "Person Group" Case 5 : entryType = "Server Group" End Select out = out & " " & aclEntry.Name & " | " & lvl & " | " & entryType & Chr(10) Set aclEntry = acl.GetNextEntry(aclEntry) Loop On Error GoTo 0
' ============================================================== ' 6. REMINDER FORM FIELDS (commented out) ' ============================================================== ' out = out & Chr(10) & "=== REMINDER FORM FIELDS ===" & Chr(10) ' On Error Resume Next ' Set remForm = db.GetForm("Reminder") ' If Not remForm Is Nothing Then ' remFields = remForm.Fields ' For j = 0 To UBound(remFields) ' out = out & " - " & remFields(j) & Chr(10) ' Next j ' Else ' out = out & " (Reminder form not found)" & Chr(10) ' End If ' On Error GoTo 0
' ============================================================== ' Write inventory ' ============================================================== fileNum = FreeFile() Open "D:\Claude\DB_NSF\HR_PanCen\11_AppTest_all_inventory.txt" For Output As #fileNum Print #fileNum, out Close #fileNum
' ============================================================== ' 7. FULL DXL EXPORT (note-by-note with error trapping) ' ============================================================== Set ncAll = db.CreateNoteCollection(False) ncAll.SelectForms = True ncAll.SelectViews = True ncAll.SelectAgents = True Call ncAll.BuildCollection
fullDxl = |<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>| & Chr(10) & _ |<database xmlns="http://www.lotus.com/dxl">| & Chr(10) errLog = "" exportCount = 0
noteID = ncAll.GetFirstNoteID() Do While noteID <> "" Set stream = sess.CreateStream() Set exporter = sess.CreateDXLExporter() exporter.ConvertNotesBitmapsToGIF = False exporter.OutputDOCTYPE = False exporter.ExitOnFirstFatalError = False
Set note = db.GetDocumentByID(noteID) title = "" On Error Resume Next title = note.GetItemValue("$TITLE")(0) On Error GoTo 0
On Error GoTo ExportNext Call exporter.SetInput(note) Call exporter.SetOutput(stream) Call exporter.Process()
stream.Position = 0 chunk = stream.ReadText()
' Strip XML declaration xmlDeclEnd = InStr(chunk, "?>") If xmlDeclEnd > 0 Then chunk = Mid(chunk, xmlDeclEnd + 2) End If
' Remove leading <database ...> tag dbTagStart = InStr(1, chunk, "<database", 1) If dbTagStart > 0 Then dbTagEnd = InStr(dbTagStart, chunk, ">") If dbTagEnd > 0 Then chunk = Mid(chunk, dbTagEnd + 1) End If End If
' Remove trailing </database> tag (find last occurrence) closeDbPos = 0 tmpPos = InStr(1, chunk, "</database>", 1) Do While tmpPos > 0 closeDbPos = tmpPos tmpPos = InStr(tmpPos + 1, chunk, "</database>", 1) Loop If closeDbPos > 0 Then chunk = Left(chunk, closeDbPos - 1) End If
fullDxl = fullDxl & chunk & Chr(10) exportCount = exportCount + 1 GoTo ExportContinue
ExportNext: errLog = errLog & " FAILED: " & noteID & " (" & title & ") - " & Error$ & Chr(10) Resume ExportContinue
ExportContinue: On Error GoTo 0 Call stream.Close() noteID = ncAll.GetNextNoteID(noteID) Loop
fullDxl = fullDxl & |</database>|
' Write DXL file in chunks to handle large output fileNum2 = FreeFile() Open "D:\Claude\DB_NSF\HR_PanCen\11_AppTest_all_dxl.xml" For Output As #fileNum2 chunkSize = 65536 pos = 1 Do While pos <= Len(fullDxl) Print #fileNum2, Mid(fullDxl, pos, chunkSize); pos = pos + chunkSize Loop Close #fileNum2
' Append DXL export errors to inventory file if any If errLog <> "" Then out = out & Chr(10) & "=== DXL EXPORT ERRORS ===" & Chr(10) & errLog fileNum = FreeFile() Open "D:\Claude\DB_NSF\HR_PanCen\11_AppTest_all_inventory.txt" For Output As #fileNum Print #fileNum, out Close #fileNum End If
msgText = "Done!" & Chr(10) & Chr(10) & _ "Inventory : D:\Claude\DB_NSF\HR_PanCen\11_AppTest_all_inventory.txt" & Chr(10) & _ "Full DXL : D:\Claude\DB_NSF\HR_PanCen\11_AppTest_all_dxl.xml" & Chr(10) & Chr(10) & _ "Exported : " & CStr(exportCount) & " notes" & Chr(10) & _ "DXL size : " & Format(Len(fullDxl), "#,##0") & " chars" If errLog <> "" Then msgText = msgText & Chr(10) & Chr(10) & _ "WARNINGS: Some notes failed - see inventory file" End If MsgBox msgText End Sub
